latestTerminalSummary:
My Round 25 Opus scores are **9 in all twelve, light and dark**, so Opus passes this round. That alone doesn't make a joint pass; the joint streak is still zero.

| Category | Light | Dark |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Typography | 9 | 9 |
| Composition and spacing | 9 | 9 |
| Color harmony | 9 | 9 |
| Contrast and emphasis | 9 | 9 |
| Component visual consistency | 9 | 9 |
| Responsive visual polish | 9 | 9 |

I reviewed the frozen app (d30dbbe9, assets e29fcce0e122) live in my own tab, which is now closed. HEAD later moved to b63f3561, but nothing under `internal` or `web` changed.

**The Round 24 Network & permissions finding is fixed** in both themes:
- **Type:** the section headings are now 14/600, matching "Create new tag". The capability names are now standard field captions: 13/600 on desktop and 14/600 on phone.
- **Add button:** it is now a secondary outline with a plus icon, like Tags Add, so it no longer competes with the main buttons.
- **Empty list:** "No origins approved." now fills the space under the heading.
- **Phone (320px):** the example address fits without clipping (137.85px of text in a 164px field). The arrow sits beside the first line of the summary.
- **With an origin added:** I added an unsaved test origin at 320 in dark and light. The address sits on its own line with Remove below, and nothing overflows. I removed it and the page returned to "All changes saved".

**Earlier fixes still hold:**
- **Share:** opens at the top with Close focused at 390×640, 320×640 and 640×360, and scrolls with Done staying pinned.
- **Editor:** Tags buttons are 32px on desktop and 44px on phone. Versions dates line up. The Stored state buttons are ordered correctly.
- **Elsewhere:** the card receipt, Duplicate, Filters, Settings, the Add page, Search with no results, the shared spaces, Find and code completion all look right.

**Small issues that didn't lower any score:**
- With an origin added, its address strip looks a bit heavy in dark.
- On desktop, the Replace row in Find stops short of the Close button's right edge.
- On phone, the Settings buttons are their natural width, while editor buttons are full width.
- Unselected radio buttons in dark are grey discs.
- The Add page's mode buttons look heavy.

**Coverage limits:**
- **Not checked this round:**
  - Go to line: the shortcut didn't open it in my session.
  - Replace actions, the selection colours, and source code at other widths.
  - The widget panel, Stored assets with files, and the viewer's More menu and receipt.
  - The Add page's Paste and URL modes, the Library at 768, and Search with results or empty.
- **Short Share sizes in only one theme each:** 390×640 dark, 320×640 light, 640×360 dark.
- **Never tested:** long or unusual data, enlarged text, invalid states, hosted sign-in, or other browser engines.

I didn't read Sol's Round 25 report or any of the summary files.

Report: `docs/reviews/Exh-zrjo/round-25-opus-visual.md`
